summary: Approved exact current commit e25865b315f33cf1d4a3c6f573fbca0ad4062dca with no unresolved blocking security finding. The delta since security approval is limited to reviewer-requested accessibility hardening and its evidence: programmatically focused normal, missing, and duplicate-inert evidence headings now receive a fixed visible outline; evidence scrolling consults only the local prefers-reduced-motion media query and selects auto rather than smooth behavior when requested; and browser tests cover destination focus, focus return, missing/duplicate states, and reduced-motion navigation. These changes introduce no untrusted selector/style/HTML context, new network target, credential/configuration channel, storage, persistence, logging, dependency, or external-system behavior. The prior evidence-integrity remediation remains intact: duplicated IDs are excluded from the resolvable map and every matching control reaches only the focused inert integrity state without displaying either ambiguous record. All previously approved boundaries remain unchanged, including guarded unknown API data, inert React text rendering, the fixed relative bodyless POST and loopback Vite proxy, Vite filesystem/local-binding controls, credential-free real-proxy execution, absent committed LD_LIBRARY_PATH mutation, memory-only browser state, local synthetic/no-real-PHI claims, Node 24/npm lock integrity, unchanged backend/OpenAPI/dataset/deterministic rules, and the zero-or-one-call/no-tools Gemini boundary. The independent npm audit again reports zero vulnerabilities. Commit-bound verification passed at 79f189720b0930cac2aeb0aec4a25bf52d699734; current HEAD differs from it only by the refreshed verification report, so that passing evidence is current for this review.
